title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) PRISON STATISTICS - 1995 Though 4 Women Jails were reported in Uttar Pradesh, the total capacity of inmates in these was not made available in the report sent by the state. The States/Uts such as Himachal Pradesh, Jammu & Kashmir, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Sikkim & Delhi did not report existence of separate jails for women prisoners.
